label: Huawei OptiXaccess EA5801E-GP08-H3 box OLT
description: Huawei OptiXaccess EA5801E (GP08-H3) - 1U box-shaped GPON OLT with 8 GPON service ports, 4x 10GE/GE SFP+ upstream ports, 110 Gbit/s switching capacity, up to 256 ONTs, dual DC or AC power supplies. -40 to +65 C.
notes: From the model table: **8 GPON service ports** and **4x 10GE/GE upstream ports**, 110 Gbit/s switching capacity, 256 ONTs. The upstream ports are 10GE/GE cages, so `speedCaps` carries both 1000 and 10000 rather than a bare 10G - a GE optic in the cage must run at 1G. The GPON service ports are 2.5G downstream / 1.25G upstream, which is what `speedCaps: [1244, 2488]` records on every OLT in this catalogue. The datasheet publishes **no ferrule polish** for the PON connectors; `sc-apc` is this catalogue's PON default and matches every other OLT here, so it is an inherited convention rather than a quoted fact - recorded because a UPC/APC mismatch is a real, invisible loss. The eight-PON member; the only model in the family offered with both DC and AC supplies.
